opening.argument: The presentation explains an ordinary way to participate in stock-media marketplaces and earn money when submitted work is licensed or sold. It describes submitting photographs for approval, posting media to websites, and receiving a percentage when something sells. It also explains that picture licensing involves payment for use in work and advises checking that photographs are copyright-free before registration. The registration form and separate subscription prompt do not, by themselves, show deception or misuse. Taken together, the observable process is a practical explanation of uploading eligible photographs and sharing proceeds from marketplace sales, not evidence of a deceptive scheme or promised outcome.
